The test image shows distinctive **cream/tan colored spherical structures** that are characteristic of **sclerotia** - the resting/reproductive bodies of *Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*, the pathogen that causes White Mold. These sclerotia can appear lighter (tan/cream) when freshly formed before darkening to black. The presence of dead plant material at soil level is also consistent with white mold's stem-base infection pattern.
